newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot sets three-for-two stock split.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot sets three-for-two stock split.

text.p: Home Depot Inc said on Wednesday it set a three-for-two stock split.
To effect the split, the company declared a stock dividend of one half-share of common stock for each share outstanding, payable July 3 to shareholders as record as of June 12.
Home Depot shares were up 5/8 to 61-3/8 in morning New York Stock Exchange trading.

The company also said in a news release that it increased its quarterly cash dividend to $0.075 per share from $0.06 per share. On a post-split basis, the dividend is equivalent to $0.05 per share, the company said.
Home Depot operates 540 home-improvement stores throughout North America.
